[Council File 26-1693]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE OFFICE OF FINANCE and RESOLUTIONS relative to agreements with the California Department of Tax and Fee Administration (CDTFA) for the implementation of Measure FD. (Public Safety Committee report to be submitted in Council. If public hearing is not held in Committee, an opportunity for public comment will be provided.)
(Please visit lms.lacity.gov for background documents.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Authorizes agreements with the state Department of Tax and Fee Administration to implement Measure FD.
